name: Layer by Layer
detailed_description:
Layer by Layer is a relaxing, single player RPG in a solarpunk world where you use an oversized 3D printer to improve your village!

You've been hired as the new printing engineer for a brand new village. With a workshop and 3D printer, you'll need to make creations that will both bring your villagers joy, as well as help the community thrive!

Features

  • Start a new community. As your villagers become happier, word will spread that your new village is the place to be! Foster friendship with the unique and interesting characters that will come to stay in your village.

  • Grow and harvest resources. In this solarpunk world, you will be learning how to co-exist with nature by nurturing your surrounding environment and practicing sustainability.

  • Control a 3D Printer to craft things for your village. Explore your creativity and your problem solving skills when 3D printing objects and furniture for your fellow villagers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
